native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Focused original groups, not entire suite.

public_session_controls.scope: Original public APIs, owned directory; file-size limit affects only replacement child, not parent

key_control.scope: Original public advisory API, owned directory and distinct synthetic keys

public_concurrent_save_control.scope: Unmodified CurrentSession.save; four owned processes,100 saves each; independent Python JSON reader, one finite schedule only

findings: claim_nudge replaces every non-ASCII-alphanumeric character with underscore. Distinct synthetic event:a and event/a keys therefore collide; repeated-key refusal and reset controls pass. This does not prove actual fixed internal advisory names collide.

CurrentSession.save ignores write_all failure and renames its temporary file anyway. A child-only512-byte file limit replaces a valid167-byte state with invalid512-byte JSON while child exits0. This is a second original state-save API, separate from SessionContext.save.

CurrentSession uses one shared current.json.tmp pathname. Four original-API worker processes each perform100 saves: independent reader observes748 valid and169 invalid JSON snapshots, no missing destination, all workers exit0. One finite schedule; counts are not a general error-rate estimate.

Existing rrrah cache publication source uses uniquely owned temporary files, checks write/flush/sync errors and publishes after successful completion. Earlier regression evidence remains separate; no rrrah production changes this turn.

Session filenames are hour-granularity UTC buckets, not unique operation identifiers. Event append limit is checked before append and errors are ignored; these are source observations without new event-log controls.
harness_notes: Initial concurrency harness timed out after5 seconds during initialization before workers started. No corresponding live helper remained; retried with30-second initialization/deadline allowance, completing successfully. Timeout cause unqualified, not attributed to original logic.
The final concurrency schedule was run once after initialization allowance adjustment; no all-schedules, crash-durability or filesystem-wide guarantee.
transfer_decision: Do not adopt lossy key normalization or shared temporary-file publication. Preserve key identity and verified complete publication. No foreign implementation copied into rrrah.
limits: 58 text files and one original image reviewed;268 tracked files remain.
311 focused original tests do not establish universal serialization, advisory, concurrency, timing or host correctness.
Owned directory and child-only limits; no user state, real host hooks or external service modified.
